headline: Preview of the Fiscal Year 2028 Capital Improvement Plan and ESCO work, plus secondary school climate and enrollment updates.
summary: The meeting covers a preview of the Fiscal Year 2028 capital plan and future energy services work, along with updates on enrollment, technology, and school climate. It also includes teacher candidate elections and two executive sessions, one on a grievance from the Portland Adult Education Bargaining Unit.
items: Public comment on items not on the agenda
Personnel items: resignations, terminations, position shifts, and other hires
Committee reports on finance, policy, curriculum, and public affairs
Secondary school climate update on behavior, discipline, attendance, and personal devices
Preview of the Fiscal Year 2028 Capital Improvement Plan and future ESCO work
Executive session to consult with legal counsel
Executive session to discuss a grievance from the Portland Adult Education Bargaining Unit
location: Casco Bay High School, in person, and via Zoom (https://tinyurl.com/3c3tayaj)
